name: google-gemini-effect
blurb: SVG paths that animate based on scroll-driven motion values.
description: Sticky section with animated SVG lines that draw based on motion values, typically driven by scroll events. Displays title, description, and button overlay.
use_when: Hero sections or scroll-triggered animations in luxury/tech landing pages.
avoid_when: When animation must respect prefers-reduced-motion, or on low-motion design systems.
a11y: SVG paths are decorative; text content is semantic and accessible.

props.name: description
props.default: "Scroll this component and see the bottom SVG come to life wow this works!"
